speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and tell me exactly how long you have had these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any dark, linear streaks on your palms or soles, and have you experienced any abdominal pain or changes in your bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: These findings, particularly the sensory changes on the palms and the skin lesions, are highly suggestive of leprosy. REQUEST TEST: Skin Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Skin Biopsy findings show chronic inflammatory cells with features suggestive of leprosy.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy confirms the suspicion of leprosy, but we need to determine the specific type to guide treatment. Do you have multiple symmetric lesions with well-defined edges, or are the lesions fewer and asymmetric with poor sensation?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the hypopigmented macules with loss of sensation, eyebrow thinning, and positive biopsy, this presentation is classic for leprosy. DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease)
